name: Movinn A/S
summary: Movinn A/S provides furnished and serviced accommodation in Denmark and Sweden. The company offers furnished serviced apartments; co-living spaces, which offer plug-and-play solutions; and hotels and aparthotels. It also provides complimentary services, such as cleaning, electronics, linen, laundry, and storage services; and equipment rentals comprising baby, workstation, bike, guest bed, cosy-it-up, and Asian cooking kits. The company serves corporate clients and professionals in need of short- and long-term housing solutions. Movinn A/S was founded in 2014 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
